market.title: Shop
market.deals_note: 3 discounted items every day, one of each. Daily item limits don't apply to deals.
market.boosts_note: If you buy the same item again on the same day, its price goes up each time. Counters reset at midnight.

market.lives_note.one: Lives refill on their own, one every minute. Don't want to wait? You can get them here.
market.lives_note.other: Lives refill on their own, one every {0} minutes. Don't want to wait? You can get them here.

market.looks_note: Skins are bought once and are yours to keep. Tap a card to preview it.
market.guide.first_clear: Finishing a level for the first time
market.guide.three_stars: Getting 3 stars on a level for the first time
market.guide.perfect_chapter: Finishing all 10 levels of a chapter with 3 stars
market.guide.big_achievements: World achievements, 900 stars, 100 perfect levels, 30 daily puzzles
market.guide.top_achievements: Finishing all 500 levels, collecting all 1,500 stars
market.guide.video_gain: +25 crystals in Deals (3 a day) · +1 life when you run out (3 a day) · +1 hint when you run out (3 a day) · extra moves when you run out (5 a day)
market.no_real_money: The shop uses in-game currency only; there are no real-money purchases.
